ruleset.name: ILR curated rules
ruleset.description: A deliberately small, low-noise PMD ruleset (KAN-168), mirrored from the service standard (e.g. ilr-eligibility-service, KAN-64): high-signal rules that catch real problems on clean code without drowning the team in style nits. Widen over time as desired, kept identical to the service ruleset so a shared library and its consumers are held to the same bar.
